system_texts: The remote will not wake up; the power light doesn't work and it appears it may have been turned off.
The cost is unclear; although a figure of twelve and a half euros per remote is mentioned, the total production cost remains undefined.
There is lack of information about the cost and viability of speech recognition, and discussions have been inconsistent.
The display requires an advanced chip, making it the most expensive option.
gold_texts: The group had difficulties deciding on the placement of the buttons, the shape of the device, and whether or not to include speech recognition.
